threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

loadout.name: RAM
loadout.text: Gain 5 Magical Power and 25% Base Mana Regen on takedown, stacking infinitely. At 3 stacks gain 5% Movement Speed. Upon death, lost 50% of stacks rounded up.
loadout.plain: Each takedown permanently adds magic power and mana regen, and enough stacks add move speed. Dying loses half the stacks, so it rewards a Neon who snowballs and stays alive.

loadout.name: Aion
loadout.text: Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.
loadout.plain: Each cast adds mana regen and ability damage to heroes earns gold. Neon casts constantly to build Threads, so this keeps her mana and gold flowing.

loadout.name: Bottomless Vial
loadout.text: Killing a River Buff restores a Potion charge and grants +5 Magical Power permanently.
loadout.plain: Taking a river buff refills a potion and grants permanent magic power. A jungle or roaming habit, not tied to her abilities.

loadout.name: Runic Focus
loadout.text: Gain 0.2% increased Magical Power per 1% current Mana.
loadout.plain: More magic power while Neon's mana bar is high. Rewards poking from full mana instead of spending it all at once.

loadout.name: Soulbearer
loadout.text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.
loadout.plain: Activate for a shield, healing off magic damage and speed. Use it with Final Thread so the Overclocked burst heals her back up.

bullets: Sun Shards made each basic attack ricochet and apply on-hit at 35%, so Storm Breaker, Lightning Hawk and Sky Splitter spread beyond her main target.
Vermis added max-health damage every third hit on one hero, and Serration added 3.5% of missing health, so staying on a target paid off as it dropped.
Heightened Senses' attack speed built Momentum for Storm Breaker and Lightning Hawk faster, and Liberator's cleanse and shield let her keep shooting when caught.
Fire Blossom burned everyone near her while Iron Rose's damage reduction kept her in range, and Elafrost empowered her next basic attack after each ability cast.
Seeds of Dominion dropped a Thornbush under each Imperial Lash target and brought Lash back in about 6.9s, rooting and slowing enemies inside Fire Blossom's burn.
Every basic attack set off Overlord's splash, and her passive Thorns let allies deal 5% of their damage as bonus true damage to whoever she hit.
Nightmare Extractor cut Extract's cooldown 20% per ability cast, so weaving Contagion, Abduct and Beguile brought back the empowered hit that heals off max health.
Krix, Cannibalism and Forticus all raise max health, which makes Extract's healing bigger, while Fire Blossom burned everyone around him.
Saphir's Mantle added 10% size and max health for 6s and kept 20% of its damage as permanent health, while Overlord splashed every basic attack.
Zap O' 9-Chains made the basic attack after each ability zap nearby enemies for 100 at level 17, so every Riplash, Shock Therapy or Electrocute added damage.
Pilow weakened nearby heroes on each cast, stacking up to 3 times, and Neurotoxin added 1.5% damage taken per stack, so his casts set targets up.
Fire Blossom burned everyone near him and Forticus shielded him on taking hero damage, so standing in the middle with Electrocute up kept damage flowing.
Each ability hit set off Combustion and Tainted Scepter's Malice damage, and takedowns gave 15 instant Malice stacks plus a permanent RAM stack of magical power.
Every cast added Aion mana regen and Timewarp took 1s off cooldowns every 8s, so she kept casting while Runic Focus rewarded her high mana.
Final Thread Overclocks all her basic abilities for 8s and came back in about 66.4s; Soulbearer's 20% magical lifesteal healed her off that burst.
